title: H9: per-endpoint envelope checks are consistency checks
description: update: From domain == authenticated committer's user domain; submitMessage: From domain == sendingUri domain; groupInfo/keyMaterial: From domain == requesting credential's domain. All checked before any write. With BasicCredential, unauthenticated From and no mTLS (.16, .17) these are consistency checks, NOT security; never described otherwise. The hub cannot authenticate PrivateMessage senders (H3 franking covers it). Chosen (plan recommendation approved by Mark 2026-10-18).
